verses.1: A song for David, to be sung to the children.
verses.2: May my words be heard by Jehovah in His wisdom.
verses.3: Listen to the voice of our king and gods, for they will give you peace.
verses.4: The LORD will hear my voice in the morning. I will call out to you in the morning, and I will wait for you.
verses.5: For I do not desire evil. You shall not harm me in any way.
verses.6: The wicked shall not stand before your eyes, O you who love all evil deeds.
verses.7: May the words of lies and deceit be destroyed. May bloodthirsty and deceitful people be hated by Jehovah.
verses.8: I come before your house in great trust, to bow down before your holy sanctuary in your sight.
verses.9: May the LORD grant me justice in your laws, so that my righteous actions may be pleasing to you.
verses.10: For in his mouth there is no venom; their sacrifices are not offensive. Their bodies are buried with honor, and they will be raised again.
verses.11: Let them be punished by God for their many sins. Let them be removed from their positions, because they have sinned against you.
verses.12: And all the people of Bethel shall rejoice forever. They will praise us, and they will bless us. My lovers will love you forever.
verses.13: For you will bless the righteous LORD, just as He desires. You will adorn us with His grace.
